classification: REVIEWED STRUCTURED ADVISORY EXCEPTIONS — B0-PRE Stage-2 supply-chain audit
note: Each exception is RECORDED as an accepted_exception finding (Stage-2 never reports 0 vulnerabilities). Same reviewed policy for TEST_ONLY and authoritative. SP1 must remain exception-free. Fail closed on any additional advisory, crate/version mismatch, stale binding, duplicate, missing field, or SP1-scoped exception.

exceptions.justification: rsa is reached only via rzup (the RISC Zero toolchain manager), which uses RSA solely to verify signatures on DOWNLOADED toolchain archives. Owner decision B provisions the guest toolchain once by verified-tree extraction into an isolated RISC0_HOME and builds RISC0_BUILD_LOCKED=1 with no rzup network resolution and no downloads; the terminal backend runs --network none. The rsa signature-verification path is therefore never executed.
exceptions.review_trigger: any change to the SDK (risc0-zkvm/risc0-groth16 version), the affected crate version, the feature set, the proving runner, the resolved lockfile, or the execution mode (e.g. enabling Bonsai remote proving, which would exercise rsa)

exceptions.justification: tracing-subscriber 0.2.25 is reached only via the arkworks ark-relations crate (an optional feature dep), not as a live logging subscriber. No fmt subscriber is initialized anywhere in the compiled host graph (no tracing_subscriber::fmt/FmtSubscriber/fmt::init in risc0-zkvm host or ark-relations), so the vulnerable ANSI-formatting code is never executed; the actual Groth16 snark runs in the pinned docker rapidsnark backend, not host ark-groth16; and the proving path logs only trusted frozen statement/witness data.
exceptions.review_trigger: any change to the SDK (risc0-zkvm/risc0-groth16 version), the affected crate version, the feature set, the proving runner, the resolved lockfile, or the execution mode (e.g. initializing a fmt subscriber over untrusted input, which would exercise the tracing-subscriber path)
